sessions.description: Target 9:30 (stretch 9:20). Swim 75' / bike ~5:00-5:10 @ ~200 W NP (disc/aero) / run ~3:05-3:15.

rationale: Two-peak season. Syców 1/2 IM (2026-07-12) is a B-race tune-up off a 5-day mini-taper; the A-race is Malbork full IM (2026-09-06). Block order: sharpen (W1-2) -> Syców -> reset (W4) -> IM build (W5-9 with a recovery valley W7) -> 2-week taper. Swim is the limiter (CTL 4.1, ~6h/8wk) so swim freq is held at >=3/wk throughout. Bike volume is on the TT bike in race position to convert the new disc/aero setup (~20-30 W) into a free IM bike split. The IM block runs 4h+2h race-simulation bricks (W6/W8 4.0h ride + 2.0h IM-pace run, W9 4.5h + 2.0h) in place of a standalone long run those weeks — the athlete has used 3+2 bricks durably before and the run is the A-race lever, so we rehearse race legs directly. Peak weekly volume is pushed toward the 16-17h ceiling (W9 ~16.5h) while staying inside the ramp/ACWR guardrails.
